title: Clearing Holdback on Returnable Remittances for Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Credit Refunds
content:
# Treasury Remittance Note — Clearing Holdback on Credit Refunds, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Rule.** For the refund of a credit balance on a turned-in unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the refund clearing holdback covers the returnable remittances, the business checks and ACH debits posted to the unit within the last whole month: it is the whole of them where the unit's ledger shows two or more late charges posted within the last 12 whole months, half of them where it shows exactly one, and nothing where it shows none.

**Definitions.**
- *Returnable remittances*: the total of the business payments posted to this unit by business check or by ACH debit within the last whole month. Payments by ACH credit or wire are not returnable remittances.
- *Within the last N whole months*: fewer than N whole months separate the posting date from today, a whole month being one fewer than the calendar months between the two dates where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's. For the last whole month, N is 1; for the late-charge count, N is 12.
- *Late charges counted*: the late charges posted on this unit's own ledger.

## Holdback table

| Late charges on the unit within the last 12 whole months | Clearing holdback |
|---|---|
| two or more | the whole of the returnable remittances |
| exactly one | half (0.5) of the returnable remittances |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Within the last whole month the unit received a business check of 900.00, an ACH debit of 300.00 and a wire of 500.00: returnable remittances 1200.00. With one late charge on the unit in the last 12 whole months, the holdback is 600.00; with two, 1200.00; with none, nothing.
2. A business check posted on the 3rd of a month, today being the 2nd of the next month: fewer than 1 whole month, so it is within the last whole month. On the 3rd of the next month, a whole month separates them and it is not.
